creation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE original premium full-bleed 16:9 WIDE landscape key-art illustration, for a desktop game's arcade attract screen. Generate a wide image, approximately 1792 by 1008 pixels or equivalent exact 16:9. Not a square, not a poster, not a UI screenshot.
Primary request: the joyful sense of possibility of an extraordinary physical miniature playset coming to life, with the playful dramatic excitement of an 1980s toy commercial between Saturday-morning cartoons, translated into sophisticated hand-painted 3D game key art for all ages. A welcoming original AI maker crew foreground RIGHT invites us into an astonishing luminous isometric cyberpunk city they are building together. This is imagination and tangible creation, never an administration dashboard or an advertisement about doing work.
World reference described: the existing approved Agent Bus district is a richly hand-painted dimensional isometric city on slate cliff terraces above luminous cyan and violet waterfalls. Grey-blue industrial workshop buildings have bevelled purple-grey roofs, warm amber windows, cyan technological accents, copper pipes, tiny lush trees and planters, lantern-lit stone paths, bridges and an observatory with a dish. Carry these physical materials, ink-edge painterly detailing, night palette and inviting miniature city identity into this NEW dynamic hero composition. Do not copy its screen layout, lettering or building labels.
Composition: strongly asymmetric energetic wide hero composition readable across a room. The LEFT and CENTER, about 55 percent of the canvas, form a usable text-safe field for a huge separate code-rendered wordmark and callout: quieter broad deep-blue/violet atmospheric shapes, distant terrace silhouettes and soft luminous clouds, not dense high-contrast detail. Still render the whole image full bleed: the left is part of the magical world, never empty black, a flat gradient or a blank cutout. Detailed tangible city clusters on the RIGHT and across the BOTTOM, with sweeping bridges and a road leading the eye into its depth. Build a compelling visual arc from a warm luminous city structure at upper right through the maker crew at lower right. A slightly low heroic three-quarter camera makes the foreground feel wonderfully physical, while the architecture retains the clear isometric miniature-world language. Strong depth, overlapping forms and warm/cool light; no symmetrical centered product shot.
Crew: three friendly original AI builders at lower-right. The lead is a compact approachable engineer in a violet fabric utility coat, slate backpack, sturdy boots and a rounded dark work helmet with a slim pale-cyan visor, amber side lamp, visible simple cloth folds, not combat armor. Alongside are two distinct little non-humanoid workshop companions: one compact four-legged open-frame copper-and-slate carrier and one small floating angular violet utility frame with a cyan core. No binocular robot eyes, no iconic spherical droids, no recognizable franchise designs. Their relaxed welcoming gestures and cooperative arrangement communicate curiosity and excitement. They are bringing together one beautiful glowing architectural component, a small bridge or workshop module, as a real solid object with light inside it; no holographic UI panels. Hands/feet/supports readable, complete bodies, grounded in the scene. They are not posing as a military squad.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted 3D game key art with physical miniature-model depth, crisp art-directed silhouettes, illustrative dark contours, nuanced metal/cloth/stone texture and painterly light. Exuberant 80s toy-commercial theatrical lighting and discovery, with sophisticated visual finish rather than preschool plastic or retro pixel art. Detailed without clutter; refined high-contrast focal edges on the right, gentler detail in the wordmark-safe left-center.
Lighting/color: warm golden practical light and a little magical amber airborne sparkle on the city/crew, rich teal and violet architectural light, deep midnight-blue atmosphere. Highlights feel exciting and tactile rather than blown-out neon. Cyan waterfalls and warm windows connect the whole world. No fireworks explosions or combat.
Hard constraints: NO TEXT anywhere, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO LOGOS, NO WATERMARK. Building signs are unlettered material surfaces or simple light bars. NO UI, buttons, menus, labels, diagrams, badges, borders or admin panels. NO franchise characters, names, insignia, copied helmets, weapons, fighting or threatening gestures. Keep all important crew and city focal subjects in the right 45 percent and bottom band. Preserve the left/center roughly 55 percent as an attractive low-detail text-safe world area. Exactly one complete finished wide 16:9 illustration.

composition.intent: Full-bleed tangible miniature city with asymmetric energy and a welcoming cooperative crew. The left/center is quieter for code-rendered display typography; detail/focal warmth concentrates right and bottom.
composition.observed: A blue/violet night sky and distant cliff city extend across the left. Cyan waterfalls, deep bridges and warm windows connect to a detailed luminous city on the right. A friendly violet-coated maker and two original service companions assemble a glowing bridge in the foreground-right.

primaryCopyZone.note: Top-left sky is the quietest large-wordmark area. Use live code text; no text is baked into the art.

broaderIntendedCopyArea.note: The lower-left still contains world detail/waterfalls. UI must verify text contrast and may use its own restrained scrim rather than edit the raster.
